name: Gauḍapāda
summary: Traditional author of the Kārikā on the Māṇḍūkya Upaniṣad; the text itself does not name its author. Its four prakaraṇas restate the Upaniṣad (ch.1), argue the unreality of dream and waking (ch.2), teach non-birth by the space analogy and give counsel on restraining the mind (ch.3), and argue non-origination and the firebrand image (ch.4).
